fixed.explanation: runDaemonForContext called browser.bind for every created context, and the second bind throws because a server is already running. The fix tracks bound browsers in a WeakSet, so each browser is bound and paused once. Later contexts on the same browser return early. I couldn't see the callers, so returning true on the early exit is a guess about what they expect.

query.intent: Code in the Playwright Test debug integration that, on each browser context creation, exposes the browser to the CLI tool (starts a browser server / binds the browser for the session). It must be made idempotent so the browser is exposed only once, with later contexts reusing it instead of throwing an "already running" error.
query.symptom: With the debug mode that attaches a paused test to the Playwright CLI, creating a second browser context throws an error that a browser server is already running.

history.analysis: runDaemonForContext is called for each created context when debug is 'cli'. It calls browser.bind(sessionName) every time, so the second context throws because a server is already running. It needs a guard so the browser is bound and the pause requested only once.
